questions.stem: Use the Factor Theorem to determine if (x - 4) is a factor of f(x) = x^3 - 12x^2 + 48x - 64.
questions.solution: The Factor Theorem states that if (x - c) is a factor of a polynomial f(x), then f(c) = 0. In this case, f(4) = (4)^3 - 12(4)^2 + 48(4) - 64 = 0, so (x - 4) is a factor.
questions.explanation: To verify decomposition using the Factor Theorem, we evaluate the polynomial at the value that would make the factor zero.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be to choose 'No' because f(4) = 0. This fails because the theorem states that if f(c) = 0, then (x - c) is a factor.
